NOTES & UPDATES

Learning,
out in the open.

A record of what I’m building, what I’m learning and where I’m heading next.

24 OCTOBER 2026 · RELEASE CHECKPOINT

Stronger foundations, smoother exploration

Commecs now coordinates provider cooldowns across server instances and answers simple location questions from saved official evidence. TechNova adds persistent categories, tighter checkout checks and an updated Android demo package. EduPredict stores new CSV uploads, reports and assignment attachments in MongoDB, with owner and cohort access checks.

The portfolio now uses sharper device previews, smoother scene changes and a higher frame rate on capable phones, while conserving rendering on constrained devices. Each project links to its current source and release documentation, including what was tested and what still depends on external services or device testing.

21 OCTOBER 2026 · WORKFLOW UPDATE

Finishing the everyday workflows

Shape Up now includes a full account export, password-confirmed account deletion, support email with confirmed inbox delivery, atomic food logging and clearer reminder preferences. The frontend build tools and dependencies were modernised, with route and PDF loading split to reduce the initial download.

Commecs now backs off blocked faculty refreshes and retains older evidence as dated reference material without presenting it as current verification. Across both projects, 441 automated checks passed; Shape Up also passed 57 defined production workflow checks using synthetic accounts. Free provider availability, source freshness and ongoing maintenance remain practical limits.

20 OCTOBER 2026 · APPLICATION UPDATE

More dependable AI, better reading

Shape Up now has live AI coaching, conversation context and clearer provider-error handling. Profile saving, first-food calorie totals and reminders were repaired and tested with synthetic demo data.

Commecs AI Assistant now keeps new answers at their beginning, handles greetings without an external API call and improves bounded recovery when a provider or optional retrieval service is unavailable. Both applications passed automated checks and live desktop and mobile reviews. External provider availability and source freshness still need ongoing attention.

17 OCTOBER 2026 · PORTFOLIO UPDATE

Bringing four projects online

My current work spans React and TypeScript, the MERN stack, Flutter and Firebase, and Python with Flask. I’m bringing those projects together here so visitors can explore the actual applications as well as their source.

Shape Up and EduPredict now have checked account and personal data flows. TechNova now offers an Android demo APK alongside its browser demo, with Home Screen instructions for iPhone and iPad. Commecs AI Assistant continues to provide a conversational interface to public college material.

At this launch checkpoint, Shape Up’s external AI integration was unavailable. It was restored and tested on 20 October, as recorded above. I’ll keep updating this portfolio as the projects develop.
